text_block_list.text:
Working as a Trainer at Tracen Academy is intense, grueling work.
Even more so for a rookie who has just taken up the post.

Desperate to adjust to the job yet constantly spinning my wheels,
I tried my best to at least come in early. It was during that time...

text_block_list.name: Energetic Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: All right! Next up is special move practice! Here we gooo!

A girl running on the track every single morning, bright and early.
Come rain or shine, there wasn't a single morning I didn't see her.

text_block_list.name: Energetic Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Pegasus Mach... STRI-I-IKE!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Courage in my heart, passion on the turf!!
Justice Biko has arrived!!

The horsegirl who cheerfully continued her training every day—Biko Pegasus.
Just watching her gave me energy, turning it into my morning routine.
However, that day was different—

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Morning, Biko-chan! Early as always, huh!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Mornin'! ...Ah, my bad!
If you're using this lane, I'll clear out, just give me a sec!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
No, it's fine! I'm moving to the turf course starting today.
I'll be using the lane next over!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, really?! You've been saying you wanted to run
on turf for ages! Congrats!!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Thanks! Good luck in today's mock race, Biko-chan!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'll give it my all!! See ya later!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Turf, huh... ...Gah, no, no, no!
What are you thinking, Justice Biko?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Practice, practice for the mock race!!
A hero must ALWAYS march forward, after a-a-all!!

It seemed Biko Pegasus was running in a mock race today.
Since the chance was there, I decided to go see her race for real!

That afternoon—Biko Pegasus's mock race
got underway under clear, sunny skies.

Right in front of Biko Pegasus was an imposing
lead pack formed by much larger, powerfully built horsegirls.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Grrrr...!

Compared to them, the smaller-framed Biko Pegasus seemed like
she had no choice but to take the long way around to avoid the pack.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Here I go!! Pegasus—

Yet, Biko Pegasus intended to take them on head-on.
Just as I was thinking that was too reckless—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: —RAPID ARROW!!

Just like an arrow—Biko Pegasus accelerated.
Short stride, rapid cadence... the quintessential pitch running style.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: How's that?! I'm just getting starteeeed!!

Showing not a shred of fear, she pinpointed a gap in the pack...
and slipped right through with nimble, deft footwork.

Footwork made possible by her petite build and powerful pitch style,
coupled with pure courage—making full use of her strengths, Biko Pegasus won.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... I did ittt!!
Justice Biko... emerges victorious!!
Seeing her radiant run, a testament to her immense effort—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Did you just say 'cool'?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek!! Thank you so much!!
Justice Biko is always on the side of justice and everyone!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Oh, the next race! Since you're here, let's watch it together!!

Where Biko Pegasus pointed, the mock race on the turf course
was about to begin.

The horsegirls in the race streaked past right before our eyes.
Blazing across the vivid green turf like a single beam of light—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Must be nice...

Biko Pegasus gazed longingly at the mock race.
Come to think of it, this morning too—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Turf, huh... ...Gah, no, no, no!
What are you thinking, Justice Biko?!

...Back then, Biko Pegasus was looking at the turf course.
Which meant—
choice_data_list: Do you want to run on turf?
Could it be that you want to run on turf?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Huh, wha?! How did you know?!
A-Are you a psychic...?!

I told her how she looked this morning and just now,
explaining what led me to think she wanted to run on turf.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Woah, amazing! Wait, you even came to watch this morning...?
Heheh, thanks for always cheering me on!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Well, yeah, it's true. I really do wanna try running on turf.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Because the very first person I ever looked up to
was the world's coolest hero, running across the green turf...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
O-Of course, I'm not just saying it 'cause it looks cool!
I completely understand why the instructor recommends dirt.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
It's true that dirt is my strong suit.
I've got decent power, and I don't dislike the sand... But, well...
choice_data_list: Admiration is a perfectly valid reason.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
! ...Heheh~! Man, you are
a reeeeally... good person!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, come cheer for me again!
Come shake my hand at the training track, alright!

I recalled the way Biko Pegasus ran.
The outstanding sharpness born from her light footwork and speed...
choice_data_list: (She seemed like she has plenty of turf aptitude too...)

text_block_list.text:
If she had a trainer to hone those traits,
she might be able to transition to turf—and yet.
choice_data_list: (I can't just throw that out there lightly...)

text_block_list.text:
I'm still just a rookie. Offering an opinion that could
drastically alter a horsegirl's racing career is daunting.

Is my judgment truly sound? Can I take responsibility?
Until I have the resolve to step in—I should observe quietly.
